resolved_findings.resolution: Context-aware single writer gate replaces the uninterruptible mutex. The bounded context begins before queue admission; already-cancelled and process-stopped writes refuse before writing. Expired queued callers do not cancel the active writer, while in-flight blocked write expiry still cancels the job.

limits: Only the native asynchronous AppContainer boundary at original source 2f30646 plus the targeted repair at 678a68c is reviewed. No complete S2 coordinator/domain/typed-bridge/workbench acceptance, construction gate, LIVE or BOUNDED_AUTO qualification is granted.

BeforeResume and OnStream are trusted host callbacks; this review exercises callback rejection and prompt consumption, not indefinitely hung arbitrary callback code. The API documents prompt stream consumption.
Stream bounds are 4MiB per stream. A cancelled process can legitimately have drained EOF streams; callback rejection and stream overflow correctly produce StreamsDrained=false.
